lines.text: The Parkers drove two hours for the view from Kuwohi, the old Clingmans Dome, in the Smokies.
The gate was shut for ice.
In late fall, high roads in the park can close for snow and ice, and Kuwohi Road closes for winter at the end of November.
Here's the fix. Check the park's road status the morning you go, and keep a lower trail as plan B.
Save this before your Smokies trip.
